list.label: Devise
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM analytics.daily_operation_summary ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM analytics.daily_operation_summary ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_date::timestamp AS time, operation_type AS metric, SUM(operation_count)::double precision AS value FROM analytics.daily_operation_summary WHERE event_date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND currency = ${currency:sqlstring} GROUP BY event_date,operation_type ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Montants par jour — devise sélectionnée
panels.description: Volume des mouvements, pas bénéfice bancaire. Aucune conversion entre devises.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_date::timestamp AS time, operation_type AS metric, SUM(total_amount)::double precision AS value FROM analytics.daily_operation_summary WHERE event_date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND currency = ${currency:sqlstring} GROUP BY event_date,operation_type ORDER BY 1

SELECT event_date AS "Date UTC",currency AS "Devise",operation_type AS "Opération",operation_count AS "Nombre",total_amount AS "Total",min_amount AS "Minimum",max_amount AS "Maximum",computed_at AS "Calculé à",run_id AS "Exécution" FROM analytics.daily_operation_summary WHERE event_date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND currency = ${currency:sqlstring} ORDER BY event_date DESC,operation_type

SELECT started_at AS "Démarrage",status AS "État",start_date AS "Du",end_date AS "Au",source_count AS "Opérations lues",group_count AS "Groupes",error_type AS "Erreur" FROM analytics.batch_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50
